product_title: Multi-list task manager for Google Tasks refugees
implementation_summary: Local/demo MVP scaffold for TaskRefuge (pipe_2026-11-01_001 rescan): FastAPI health+lists+waitlist+import stubs, Docker Compose for Postgres/Redis (not started against paid cloud), waitlist HTML, iOS notes stub, and a local git commit. No GitHub push, no App Store binary, no Google API calls. TestClient checks confirm /health and 40 seeded lists. Satisfies Stage 6-7 as scaffold for the validate-path walkthrough.
